content_sections.heading: NEHU Project Associate-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: The upper age limit is 35 years, with a relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST candidates. Essential qualification: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering. Desirable qualifications and experience: Experience in Application Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) design or System on Chip (SoC) design. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

rows.event: Last date to email the application

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on qualification, experience and interview performance. The Selection Committee's decision will be final and binding. Applications are shortlisted, and only shortlisted candidates are informed by email or phone. Shortlisted candidates report to the Electronics and Communication Engineering Department office for certificate verification. A technical interview follows, on a date that will be sent by email. NEHU reserves all rights to select or reject a candidature and to cancel the interview without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and contractual, and it is co-terminus with the project. It runs initially up to 31 March 2027 and is renewable on a yearly basis, extendable subject to satisfactory performance. The monthly salary is subject to the availability of project funds. The selected candidate cannot claim permanent absorption in NEHU, and the Institute will not provide employment after the project ends. All other terms and conditions follow prevailing Institute rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NEHU Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Take the application form enclosed with the notice, on pages 3 and 4 of the official notification. Fill in the position, your personal and contact details, and your qualifications from 10th upward, with the university, year of passing, subject and percentage or GPA. Enter your GATE details (year, registration number, valid score, rank) and UGC NET details (year, roll number, rank), where you have them. Give your experience and number of journal publications, if any, then sign and date the form. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size colour photograph. Email the soft copy of the filled-in form to [email protected] on or before the last date. Experience certificate or details, if any Photocopy of the first page of each journal publication, if any

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply without GATE or UGC NET?
faq.answer: The notice sets a separate fellowship of Rs. 25,000 + HRA for candidates who do not fall under the NET, GATE or national-level examination category.

faq.question: Q2. Is ASIC or SoC experience compulsory?
faq.answer: No. Experience in ASIC or SoC design is listed as desirable. The essential requirement is a B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes. SC/ST candidates get a relaxation of 5 years on the upper age limit of 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. How will I know if I am shortlisted?
faq.answer: NEHU will inform shortlisted candidates by email or phone. Others will not be contacted, because only shortlisted candidates are called for interview.

faq.question: Q5. What should I bring for verification?
faq.answer: Carry a set of self-attested photocopies of your testimonials of qualifications, mark sheets, experience, date of birth and other documents, along with the originals.

faq.question: Q6. Will NEHU pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA or any other expenses will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How soon must the selected candidate join?
faq.answer: Selected candidates need to join immediately or at very short notice.
